bounded_static_trace.shared_presentation_path: Gameplay loop at $0784 calls renderer $1FC7. It waits on VBlank bit 7 at $9001, increments $6059 per wait, and increments $605A on every eighth wait. The renderer iterates ten 5-byte records from $601C, including player $6026 and enemy records $602B/$6030/$6035/$603A. At $20FA-$20FD it copies record byte +4 to sprite-device byte +2. The $20C3-$20F7 path also reads $605A when deriving a presentation value from record byte +3, subject to the record-byte and flag branches.
bounded_static_trace.limit: This proves a common sprite-publication path and a $605A-dependent presentation path. It does not prove that the semantic pose selector for player and enemy families has one shared gameplay writer, nor that $605A alone owns every pose change. Dynamic writes to player/enemy record bytes +3/+4 were not resolved in this bounded trace.
bounded_static_trace.player_path: Main gameplay calls $35FF after the enemy dispatcher. The inspected $36xx movement path reads controls and updates player status $6026 and coordinates $6027/$6028; this path did not establish a dynamic writer for $6029/$602A.
bounded_static_trace.enemy_dispatch_and_movement: Main gameplay calls $407E. It selects rate code $61C3 in $40F8 using part/difficulty and elapsed bucket $61B7>>4. $40CC combines $61C3 with fractional accumulator $61B5 to choose movement steps; $42BA processes each active enemy record. The inspected movement tail writes actor bytes +0..+2, not the graphic fields +3/+4.
bounded_static_trace.elapsed_vs_route_selection: $3A48-$3A78 decrements $61B6, reloads it to 0x3C on wrap, increments elapsed byte $61B7, and services per-enemy counters $61CE-$61D1. Route selector $4717 uses $61B7 plus DIP selection to update $61C4-$61C7; $42F4 consumes those route-choice fields. These elapsed/rate/route owners are distinct from renderer counter $605A.
